title: SaaS & Channel Integrations
subtitle: Connect enterprise SaaS tools via OAuth 2.1 PKCE and link Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, or generic Webhooks to trigger autonomous agent loops.

channels.title: Chat Channels & Inbound Adapters
channels.telegramDesc: Two-way Long-Polling bot. Message directly, stream responses, and receive proactive alerts.
channels.whatsappDesc: Connect via WhatsApp Cloud API Webhook for seamless mobile messaging.
channels.discordDesc: Listens to guild messages, @mentions, and channel threads to route prompts directly to agents.
channels.webhookDesc: Trigger autonomous agent tasks from external systems via HTTP POST.

pairing.title: Channel Pairing & Whitelist Security (Zero-Trust)
pairing.subtitle: Generate a temporary 6-digit PIN to authenticate new Telegram or WhatsApp users before they can interact with the kernel.
pairing.instructions: Send this 6-digit code or /pair <PIN> from your Telegram/WhatsApp chat to authorize your account.
pairing.empty: No channel users authorized yet. Generate a PIN above and send it from your chat.
